chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Barqi, raising it from Zayd al-Shahham, Abu Usamah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I was circumambulating with Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him). Whenever he reached the Stone, he wiped it with his hand and kissed it; and whenever he reached the Yamani Corner, he embraced it. I said, 'May I be your ransom, you wipe the Stone with your hand and embrace the Yamani Corner?' He said, 'Rasool Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: I do not come to the Yamani Corner except that I find Jibraeel (peace be upon him) having preceded me to it, embracing it.'

key_terms.يَلْتَزِمُهُ: He embraces it (referring to the ritual embrace of the corner)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of embracing the Yamani Corner during Tawaf according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the Sunnah of the Prophet and Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in Tawaf, emphasizing the tactile reverence for the Black Stone and the Yamani Corner. It provides a profound theological link to the celestial realm by noting that Archangel Jibraeel preceded the Prophet in embracing the Yamani Corner, thereby validating these physical acts as imitations of divine worship. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on following the Prophet's specific ritual details as transmitted through the Imams.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Barqy, raising if from Zayd Al Shahaam Abu Asama, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said:

‘I was circumambulating along with Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and it was so that whenever he<sup>asws</sup> ended up to the (Black) Stone, he<sup>asws</sup> wiped it with his<sup>asws</sup> hand, and kissed it; and whenever he<sup>asws</sup> ended up to the Yamani corner, embraced it’. So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! You<sup>asws</sup> wipe the (black) Stone with your<sup>asws</sup> hand, and embrace the Yamani corner?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I<sup>saww</sup> have not come to the Yamani corner except that I<sup>saww</sup> found Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> having had preceded me<sup>saww</sup> to it, embracing it’’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Barqiy in a marfu‘ manner from Zayd al-Shahham abu ‘Usamah who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Once I was performing Tawaf with my father, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and when he reached the Black Stone he touched it with his hand and kissed. When he reached al-Yemaniy corner he held it (with his hands). I then said, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, how is it that you touch the Black Stone and hold al-Yemaniy corner? He replied, ‘The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, “Whenever I would reach al-Yemaniy corner I would find Jibril arrive before me to hold al-Yemaniy corner.’””
